$comment: Ported from the Compound Labs copy gates. Each pattern carries scope flags: copy (outward copy, which is what NewsRail checks), answer and reply. A pattern may carry requires, unless (regexes tested against the sentence around the hit) and min_words.
rule: No noise. State the fact. Do not announce that you are being honest, do not say no without the word, and do not narrate the answer before giving it.
copy_rule: No filler. Copy states what happened and what it changes, in plain nouns and verbs. Phrases that fit any product (designed to, built to help, seamlessly, powerful, robust, cutting-edge, unlock, empower, supercharge, the ultimate, look no further) are banned in any wording, and so is a rhetorical hook.

1.name: performed-sincerity
1.title: PERFORMED SINCERITY
1.what: a phrase announcing that the speaker is being honest instead of being honest

2.name: euphemism-for-no
2.title: EUPHEMISM FOR NO
2.what: saying no without the word; the answer to "experience with X?" when there is none is "No experience." or "None."

3.name: narrating-the-answer
3.title: NARRATING THE ANSWER
3.what: a sentence about the speaker's stance toward the answer instead of the answer

4.name: filler-noise
4.title: FILLER NOISE IN PRODUCT COPY
4.what: describing a product or feature with padding instead of what it does; the product stands on what it does

5.name: self-putdown
5.title: COPY THAT PUTS OUR OWN PRODUCT DOWN
5.what: a clause whose subject is our own product, its output, the studio or the founder's own work, and whose predicate says it is unwanted, unasked for, unnecessary, small, a toy or a joke; a plain stated limit is not this
